issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מוּסַבֹּת שֵׁם' (lit. 'whose name was changed') is rendered as '示巴門' (Shebamon), which appears to be a misreading or misrendering of the Hebrew. The phrase indicates that the name of Nebo and Baal-meon was changed, not a separate place name '示巴門'. This changes the meaning: the Hebrew says the names of these cities were changed, whereas the Chinese introduces a third city name not in the text.
